reviewer: Codex AI static-PNG review (not owner approval)

single-stratocumulus.note: Hierarchical Cached/Hybrid restore irregular mid-scale clumps and internal gaps relative to global-only without an obvious static atlas boundary. Still PNGs do not establish camera/wind/LOD phase continuity or per-Body Support/metadata ownership.

single-altocumulus.note: Hierarchical normal, ground shadow, and density-debug show regular vertical grid/barcode structure. Extra sharpness is not accepted as credible Ac cellular recovery; motion and Support ownership remain unproven.

single-cirrocumulus.note: Hierarchical output changes the smooth global-only sheet into a regular lattice with parallel ground-shadow stripes. Static images cannot establish whether it is camera/world locked or validate Support metadata.

w8-cellular-scale.note: The three soft global-only bodies become strong near-equidistant vertical bands/columns, repeated in the ground shadow and density debug. Aggregate diagnostics are healthy but do not prove per-Body attribution or motion stability.

w8-cellular-overlap.note: The hierarchical overlap is visibly fuller/brighter and gains regular fine bands. No static NaN, Support leak, or black hole is obvious, but stills cannot exclude double-density or metadata mis-attribution.

w8-wave-ripple.note: Global-only soft patches become very regular stripe columns. One frame cannot distinguish an intended body/world-stable ripple from atlas or screen locking, nor prove phase continuity or Support ownership.

w9-brick-lod-sweep.note: The fixed LOD scene restores distinct mid-scale detail versus global-only with no obvious static black hole or atlas edge. The benchmark does not move the camera through LOD thresholds, so popping, generation continuity, and per-Body ownership remain unproven.

w9-brick-overflow.note: The 5-candidate scene remains visually coarse like global-only, consistent with whole-tile fallback; raw diagnostics report overflowTiles=32 and maxCandidates=5. Static evidence does not prove transitions or per-sample metadata correctness.

w9-thin-ridge-proxy.note: Hierarchical Cached/Hybrid keep the thin ridge substantially more continuous than the separated global-only blobs. Motion, layout-generation switching, and Support metadata still require external evidence.
